description: The plugin and marketplace manifests validate strictly, their versions agree, and the SessionStart hook covers every session source.
why: Every failure this catches is invisible at runtime. A misspelled manifest field still loads the plugin, minus whatever it configured. Drifted versions ship a plugin that misreports itself. A hook matcher missing `resume` cost nothing observable until a resumed session started with no stage map — which is the exact failure keel exists to prevent.
fixHint: Run `claude plugin validate ./plugins/keel --strict` to see the manifest complaint; for version drift, bump both plugin.json and the marketplace entry together.
